nodes.label: Rejeição de campos vazios
nodes.rationale: Empty fields are rejected before any validation runs.

nodes.label: Hierarquia de exceções personalizadas
nodes.rationale: All custom errors inherit from ValidacaoError so a single 'except ValidacaoError' catches any business-rule violation, and each error carries campo, valor and motivo for the report.

nodes.label: Padrão regex de nome
nodes.rationale: Requires first name and surname separated by \s; [^\W\d_] accepts only letters including accented ones.

nodes.label: Padrão regex de telefone
nodes.rationale: DDD in parentheses, optional space, optional leading 9 so both landline and mobile numbers are accepted.

nodes.label: Dígitos verificadores do CPF
nodes.rationale: Regex only checks shape; after it the program checks the CPF check digits and rejects CPFs with all-equal digits, because those pass the format but are not real CPFs.

nodes.label: Validação com Expressões Regulares (re)
nodes.rationale: All patterns use raw strings and are anchored with ^ and $ so the whole value must match the format, not just a fragment. Dots in CPF are escaped because a bare '.' matches any character.

nodes.label: dados/clientes.csv
nodes.rationale: Example input with a mix of valid and invalid records (13 rows, 4 valid / 9 invalid) to exercise every validation rule.

nodes.label: Relatório formatado com f-strings
nodes.rationale: Report with statistics (totals, valid/invalid percentages, errors per field), a table of valid records and a per-line list of invalid records with reasons.

nodes.label: saida/relatorio.txt
nodes.rationale: Generated automatically on execution; default output destination, overridable with -o.

nodes.label: Sistema de Análise de Dados em Python
nodes.norm_label: sistema de analise de dados em python
nodes.rationale: Deliverable of Semana 05 (Desafio Sprint 5): reads a client CSV, validates fields with regex, handles errors with try/except/else/finally and custom exceptions, and produces an f-string report shown in terminal and saved to file. Requires Python 3.8+ and no external libraries.

nodes.label: datetime.strptime
nodes.rationale: Used after the date regex to confirm the date actually exists (31/02 is rejected); a business rule additionally forbids future dates.

nodes.label: Faixa de idade 18 a 120 anos
nodes.rationale: Idade is converted with int() instead of regex to demonstrate ValueError from type conversion, then must be within 18-120.

nodes.label: ValueError
nodes.rationale: Raised by int('vinte') on idade or strptime('31/02/2024') on data; the record is marked invalid with the reason and processing continues.

nodes.label: dados/clientes_sem_telefone.csv
nodes.rationale: Input file deliberately missing the 'telefone' column to demonstrate the KeyError path.

nodes.label: KeyError
nodes.rationale: Raised by linha[campo] when a required CSV column is missing; reports the missing column and lists expected columns.

nodes.label: FileNotFoundError
nodes.rationale: Raised by open() in ler_csv when the file does not exist; prints an error and exits with code 1.

nodes.label: OSError
nodes.rationale: Raised when writing the report fails (e.g. no permission); prints an error and exits with code 1.

nodes.label: Blocos try/except/else/finally
nodes.rationale: try runs CSV read or report write; except catches each error type separately with a specific message; else runs only on success and confirms record count; finally always runs, even when except returns, to signal the end of the stage.
